AlbumCreditItem.description: One person's credit on a record, mirroring `release_personnel`.
AlbumCreditItem.title: AlbumCreditItem

AlbumUnitBlock.description: One official record as a whole object: what is on it and who made it.
AlbumUnitBlock.title: AlbumUnitBlock

ConversationTurn.description: A browser-safe projection of one human or final assistant message.
ConversationTurn.title: ConversationTurn

EditorialBlock.description: Flexible model-shaped material rendered in one of several visual forms.

items.description: Up to twelve items: a fact_grid or timeline is a designed comparison of a small set. A complete set of people belongs in a person_roster, which holds the whole list.
items.title: Items

presentation.description: narrative for prose; fact_grid for a compact set judged on shared terms, including attributed viewpoints; timeline for a sequence.
presentation.title: Presentation

EditorialBlock.title: EditorialBlock

detail.description: One or two sentences of context or evidence for this item.
detail.title: Detail

follow_ups.description: Up to three topics the visitor might want more about, each a short label plus the specific question it opens when pressed, rendered as chips under 'More about'.
follow_ups.title: Follow Ups

link.description: An outbound link for this item; kept only when its URL appeared in a tool result this turn.

marker.description: A short label that classifies or indexes this item and renders as small type above the subject: a year, a date, a set position, or a category such as 'The skeptical view'. Never the subject itself.
marker.title: Marker

title.description: The specific subject of this item, rendered as its heading: a song, show, person, place, fact, or claim. Put measurements and assessments in value or detail.
title.title: Title

value.description: The concise measurement or assessment for the subject, such as '330 performances, 1972–1995' or 'Track six'. A short value renders as display type; a sentence renders as text.
value.title: Value

EditorialLink.description:
An outbound link the model attaches to something it wrote.

The server keeps a link only when its URL appeared in material the tools
returned during the same turn; anything else is dropped before rendering.
EditorialLink.title: EditorialLink

EraUnitBlock.description: A stage of a development the composer names, with representative listening.
EraUnitBlock.title: EraUnitBlock

ExperienceGroup.description:
A model-selected relationship between one or more body blocks.

``block_indexes`` preserves the composer's reading order after references
have been resolved. The browser only renders this supported presentation;
it never re-groups or re-orders the material.
ExperienceGroup.title: ExperienceGroup

FollowUpTopic.description:
A short topic chip the visitor can press, and the full question it stands for.

The chip shows only the label under "More about"; pressing it sends the
question, in the visitor's voice, to start a new turn. Only the composer
writes these; the server never generates one.
FollowUpTopic.title: FollowUpTopic

GuestAppearanceListBlock.description: Canonical guest-show relationships for one resolved person.
GuestAppearanceListBlock.title: GuestAppearanceListBlock

ListenAction.description: A listening destination attached to the object it plays.
ListenAction.title: ListenAction

PerformanceUnitBlock.description: One rendition as a primary object, with its set context and listening actions.
PerformanceUnitBlock.title: PerformanceUnitBlock

PersonRosterBlock.description:
A complete set of people, organized under one model-chosen heading.

The inventory component for questions that ask for everyone: the model
names the section and chooses who belongs in it; the server supplies each
person's name, roles, show count and span.
PersonRosterBlock.title: PersonRosterBlock

PersonRosterItem.description: One person in a roster: identity and appearance facts from the store, one note from the model.
PersonRosterItem.title: PersonRosterItem

ShowSelectionBlock.description: A clearly attributed selection of shows from one reviewed source.
ShowSelectionBlock.title: ShowSelectionBlock

ShowUnitBlock.description:
One show as a primary object of the answer, hydrated from the store.

The composer supplies the interpretive fields (emphasis, note, highlights,
preferred recording, sources, follow-up topics); date, venue, setlist, guests and
listening actions come from canonical data.
ShowUnitBlock.title: ShowUnitBlock

SongHistory.description: A song's stage life: first, last, and one performance per year.
SongHistory.title: SongHistory

SongRepresentativePerformance.description: A model-chosen rendition that gives a song unit an immediate listening path.
SongRepresentativePerformance.title: SongRepresentativePerformance

UnitSource.description: Evidence the composer associated with one unit, resolved to a grounded URL.
UnitSource.title: UnitSource
